def: The anterior region or head of insects and other arthropods.Packard.
Of pertaining to crinoids; consisting of, or containing,crinoids.
A board, or frame of planks, lowered over the side of a vesselto lessen her leeway when closehauled, by giving her greater draught.
One belonging to a clan or tribe having a totem.-- To`tem*is"tic, a.
The posterior part of the medulla oblongata. B. G. Wilder.
a. & n. from Rage, v. i.-- Ra"*ging*ly, adv.
One of a fabulous race of dwarfs who waged war with the cranes,and were destroyed.
To cause to be no longer deceived; to free from deception,fraud, fallacy, or mistake. South.
To broil. [Obs.] "We had a calf's head carboned". Pepys.
